painting.title: The Potato Eaters
painting.holding: Van Gogh Museum, Amsterdam (Vincent van Gogh Foundation)

comparable_sale.work: The Red Vineyard (1888), the only painting Van Gogh sold through a show in his lifetime
comparable_sale.note: Used as the era's market-price anchor. The Potato Eaters itself never sold.

worker_wage.basis: US farm hand ~$1.50-1.75/day excl. board; manufacturing ~$1.44-1.61/day (Weeks/Aldrich reports, 1885). Dutch day-labourer ~ƒ1/day (~$0.40). We use the US figure as the 'street' anchor and show the Dutch figure in METHODS.md.

bread.note: US 4-5¢/lb loaf typical mid-1880s (city bakery). Used for stack visual.

house.note: Typical modest US wood-frame house $1,000-2,500 mid-1880s. Used for house visual.

now_2026.label: 2026 — The Street (today)
now_2026.benchmark_note: Representative major-Van Gogh auction/private benchmark (~$70M). For context: record is $117.2M Orchard with Cypresses (Christie's NY, Nov 2022); $81.3M Laboureur dans un champ (2017); $71.5M Self-Portrait Without Beard (1998); ~$70M private offer reported for Vase with Daisies and Poppies (NYT, 2023). The Potato Eaters itself is collection-held and priceless.

worker_wage.basis: BLS Current Population Survey 2025 annual avg: $1,204/wk full-time median ($1,089 women / $1,326 men). BLS OEWS May 2025 mean: $69,770. We visualise the median.

bread.note: US average sandwich loaf ~$2.50-3.00 in 2025-26. We use $3.00 and label it.

house.note: Approx. US median existing-home price 2025 (~$410-415k). We use $412k and label it.

derived.formula_note: workdays = price / daily wage; years = price / annual wage; loaves = price / loaf price; houses = price / house price. Rounded for display; exact math lives in script.js.
